name: Draw & Donate 🎨
desc:
Draw & Donate is a game where you can claim a canvas and draw whatever you can imagine! Showcase your artistic talent, receive likes, and donate or make Robux all in one!

Unleash your creativity and meet other artists around the gallery! Donations can take a few days to process, and the donations you receive will be less due to Roblox taxes.

🖌️ Draw fun art! 
👍 Receive lots of likes! 
💸 Donate or earn Robux!

Check out Build & Donate here! https://www.roblox.com/games/16482659669/Build-Donate
